title: Estrada: cotton joints and cyanoacrylate glue
summary: Flavio Estrada tells of Estrada: cotton joints and cyanoacrylate glue, about 2023-2025 at Peru, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They use cyanoacrylate, and it gives it quite an interesting hardness, right?

plain: Flavio Estrada, a researcher in Peru who has examined small three-fingered mummy-like figures that some claim are not human, talks about them on Jesse Michels' podcast. He says the joints of the figures are made with cotton and cyanoacrylate, a strong superglue, which gives them a surprising hardness. If so, it would mean the figures were put together by people in modern times.
